description: The autonomy.grant refusal for a merge grant without an expiry (S56 T6, the -31833 family): irreversible authority is bounded and renewable — a merge grant without an expiry would be standing authority to merge that only a revocation could end. The validator refuses the missing expiry with the pure sentence; a bounded expiry is always accepted instead (the limits say how far out one may run — see grant-expiry-too-far).

data.what: forge.merge must carry an expiry — irreversible authority is bounded and renewable
data.means: a grant is a human-authored authority record with closed rules (subject, conditions, expiry, the node it may sit on); a request outside them is refused, not silently corrected — nothing was written
data.todo: the refusal names the rule it broke and the thing it broke it on; `autonomy.vocabulary` lists the closed sets a request may name
